tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rab gnas 'bring po'i ngag 'don bkra shis chu rgyun bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza ya/ 'dir rab gnas kyi cho ga 'bring po gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la sbyar ba ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa las ngag 'don gang yin zur bkol ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs dkyil chog bzhin la/ sngon gtor tshig lhug gi bsgyur kha ji srid rab gnas kyi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du zhes sbyar/ bdag bskyed sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gang rung gi nyer bsdu'i bar byas la rnam rgyal dang las bum sgrub tshul dkyil chog bzhin dang / khrus bum brgyad sgrub tshul don gnyis lhun grub sogs rab gnas kyi gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la las sngags bgegs mthar byed kyis byed pa tsam khyad par/ zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sbyangs ba rnams spyi 'gre la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes khyad par/ sdig pa sbyang ba khrus sdig pa ci yang sogs/ ring bsrel bzhugs pa/ ngo mtshar chen po sogs/ sems bskyed rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre bzhin/ rten bskyed ni/ bigh+nan ta kris bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos srung nor lha'i sku thams cad pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ 'di tshig sdud byas pa yin gyi gdan spyi 'gre pad+ma dang / zhi ba la zla ba/ khro bo la nyi ma/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ de las rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor rnams paṃ las pad+ma sogs/ rab gnas gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/

so so'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gdan gyi steng du gtso 'khor thams cad sa bon dang phyag mtshan gong bzhin dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i sogs gong bzhin dang / chos po ti dang / gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams a las pad+ma/ de las 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i sogs/ sāts+tshā sogs thugs mchod rten gyi rigs rnams pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo/ de las rnam snang dkar po dkar nag sogs/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten sogs/ bum pa'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sogs rnam snang gong bzhin/ shar du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las mi bskyod pa sogs/ lhor pad+ma dang / rin po che'i steng du swā las nor bu/ de las rin 'byung sogs/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po'i steng du āḥlas pad+ma/ de las 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du hā las ral gri/ de las don grub sogs/ gur zhal sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi sku rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po sku mdog mthing nag khro bo dang sogs srung 'khor gyi skabs bzhin/ gtsug lag khang ni mchod rten sor bzhag la mchod rten gyi khyad chos rnams dor ste/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa zhes pa'i rjes su lha de thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la/ zhes pa nas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan la/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes sbyar rten so so ngo shes shing mngon rtogs blo la yod na lha de dang der rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed bya zhing / zhal bsgyur mi dgos/ gtsug lag khang gi byang shar du chos skyong shar lhor nor lha rnams bskyed pa rnams legs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/

rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ phyi 'brang bskrad pa/ byon legs khrus gsol/ gdan 'bul/ dri sngon 'gro'i mchod pa rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyi phyag rgya rnams kyai rdor bzhin la/ oṃ ya man+ta kṛ ta dzaḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang nye bar spyan drangs/ oṃ pra dzñā na ta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa rnams zhugs/ oṃ pad+man ta kṛ ta baṃ/ zhes pas ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ bi bha nan ta kṛ ta hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing bstim mo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan 'dren bstim/ sku gsung thugs rgyas btab rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre la bstim pa'i skabs su gong bzhin no/ /dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ rū pa rdo rje sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ rten bigh+nan ta kṛ ta dang / las bum gyi chus bsangs/ gtso bo'i dbang lha'i gtso bo yin/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rten rnams la phog pas 'od kyi lam nas dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas lha mo'i pad+mar 'thon pa/ oṃ 'khor lo sogs/ kha nang du bskyed pa/ dbang lha spyan 'dren/ gsol gdab/ nang dbang / dbang stegs la rten rnams gang yod kyi sar dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor de yod snyam pa'i mos pa byed/ bkod nas lus dkyil rnams bdag 'jug bzhin la/ rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor gyur/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bstim/ rgyas gdab/ dbang rdzas bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bstim/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ rgyas btab/ mchod bstod zhu ba/ dbang bskur bar gdams pa/ sngags bcas/

bkra shis/ dbang bskur/ rgyas btab/ dbang lha bstim pa/ mchod pa rnams bya zhing / rtogs bskyed dang / rdo rje'i glu/ bskor ba rnams mi dgos/ rin 'byung nas bzung mi bskyod pa ming dbang gi bar la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gre sbyar bas shes shing / dbang de thams cad la rtogs bskyed mi dgos/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long gi rjes gnang gnyis pa dang / mi bskyod pa'i lung bstan dbugs dbyung / slob dpon gyi maṇ+ḍal gsol btab rnams mi dgos/ rigs bzhi'i slob dpon du sgrub byed phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang / bdag po chen po'i dbang rnams bdag 'jug bzhin la rang nyid dang rang zhes pa'i tshig gang yod dor/ slob dpon gyi mchod pa'i bar bya/ dam tshig bzlas lung / yon 'bul/ spro ba bskyed pa/ rjes gnang / rtogs bskyed/ gsang dbang gi maṇ+ḍal gsol btab/ mig dar 'ching ba rnams mi dgos/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sogs gsang rdzas sgrub ster/ bkra shis/ rten rnams 'od dpag med du gyur zhes brjod/ rtogs bskyed/ sher dbang gi maṇ+ḍal gsol btab/ gdong bcings rnams mi dgos/ rig ma yid 'ong nas ho bar/ rten rnams thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / rig ma reg rdo rjer gyur pa zhes sogs nas/ slar rin 'byung du gyur/ hūm̐ bar ngo sprod/ brtul zhugs/ lan 'debs/ gdong dbye/ rtogs bskyed/ bzhi pa'i maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs/ gdong bcings rnams mi dgos/ dngos po thams cad nas/ rang bzhin no bar/ de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan bar rab gnas spyi 'gre bzhin/ dbang bskur la 'di ltar dgos pa yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsang 'dus rab gnas la bab pas shes ldan gyi rtogs nus shing / bum chu dbu brgyan dar dpyangs/ rdor dril/ me long / rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyi tsaka li bdud rtsi rnams so so'i tshig brjod pa dang rten gyi drung du 'bul lo/

/mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' rnams 'og ma kun la'ang sbyar la/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra dhū pe/ mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing / /phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra di paṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yis/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /rang byung nyid la 'bul bar bgyi/ /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra ghan+dhe/ kha dog dri ro nus ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /badz+ra nai wi te/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston pa/ /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shap+ta zhes dang / dharmā ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo dbul lo/ de nas mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /zhes sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / snang stong ma dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga/ spyan dbye/ mchod bstod brtan bzhugs rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre bzhin la/ brtan bzhugs lan gsum grub nas/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen dbang po snang ba mtha' yas dpal/

/don grub la sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /zag med bde ba'i dbang phyug bde gshegs yum/ /spyan ma mā ma ki dang gos dkar mo/ /sgrol ma la sogs rigs kyi lha mo rnams/ /sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /byams pa sa snying gtsug tor nam snying po/ /'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug kun tu bzang / /sgrib sel la sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ma lus rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes byed pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje dang / /chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs sems ma rnams/ /sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /gshin rje gshed dang shes rab pad mthar byed/ /bgegs sgra mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can/ /stobs chen gtsug tor can dang gnod mdzes rnams/ /sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas rten 'di la/ /'gro ba'i don du mi 'bral brtan bzhugs nas/ /sbyin bdag dge zhing shis par mdzad du gsol/ /ji srid sa sogs 'byung ba chen po bzhis/ /sku gzugs gnod par ma gyur de srid du/ /thugs rje che ldan mgon po bcom ldan rnams/ /brtan par bzhugs nas bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig gis brtan bzhugs bya zhing rol mo dang bcas pas/ rten gyi gnas gsum du rdo rje reg pas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /bla ma yid dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos srung nor lha sogs rdo rje 'chang dang / rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa rnams zhal bsgyur/ gur zhal sogs zhe sdang rdo rjer bskyed pa dang / po ti 'od dpag med du bskyed pa rnams zhal bsgyur rab gnas spyi 'gre bzhin/

bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ dpag tu med par sprul la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /ces dang / pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dzā me gha sa mu drā s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi mchod yon dang / sngags kyi ar+ghaṃ rnams kyi gnas su lha rdzas me tog dang puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang dhū paṃ/ snang gsal dang dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang ghan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas dang nai wi d+yaṃ/ sil snyan dang shap+ta/ ces pa rnams bcug cing / gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra bar sbyar la/ dharmā ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo rgya cher dbul lo/ /de nas rang gi snying ka nas rdo rje ma lnga spros la/ de nas mchod par bsam ste/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog can gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang / gsum pa 'dra bar sbyar la/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /dbang sngon mdog can sgra'i rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas sgra yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ aḥshap+ta badz+ri hūm̐/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /gser zangs mdog can dri yi rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dri yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+ri hūm̐/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nyi ma'i mdog can ro yi rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/

/rgyal ba sras bcas ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ āḥr sa badz+ri hūm̐/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha'i mdog can reg bya rdo rje ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs bla bstod/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs yi dam gyi bstod pa po ti dang / mchod rten gyi bstod pa/ snang stong ma/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga/ mnyam nyid ma/ spyi bye brag gi mnga' dbul/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang chabs cig 'o thug sgrub pa'am/ tsa ru'i bza' ba sngags kyi mnga' dbul/ bkra shis bcas/ mchod bstod/ gtor bsngo bskang ba/ chos skyong bsgo ba gtor 'bul/ yig brgya sngon 'gro'i lhag chad kha skong / nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ rten med gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung ba rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre bzhin/ khyod kyi nga la sogs yon bdag bsgo ba'i skabs su las bum gyi chu dang / las sngags/ shu n+yā ta rnams kyis bsangs sbyangs byas la/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du rdo rje 'chang sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma sngon po/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khro bo spyan 'dren/ bgegs bskrad/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad gtod pa/ mchod bstod/ yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro'i bsngo ba/ dga' ston/ slar yang shis brjod/ lhag chad kha skong / yig brgya bzla ba'am/ zhe ba'i sbyin sreg rnams rab gnas spyi 'gre bya zhing / 'on kyang slob dpon gyi bsngo ba grub nas/ 'di rang khyad chos/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ /sogs bsngo ba dang / bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg kyang byed par spro na/ gsang 'dus la ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos sbyin sreg gi yig cha yod pas de bzhin bya'o// //zhes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab gnas 'bring po bya tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'dus pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho las ngag 'don zur du bkod pa yin pas bzang po drug gi rnam bzhag dang / rgyas bsdus gnyis shes par 'dod na ngor chen gyi gsung rab der blta ba dang / spyir rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs la rab gnas kyi rgyud 'di rnal 'byor rgyud dang / bla med thun mong ba yin pas/ yo ga dang / bla med kyi rgyud sde rnams la rab gnas kyi rgyud de sbyar nas so so'i khyad chos bsgyur ba'i phyag len yod pa bzhin/ 'di yang gsang 'dus la rab gnas rgyud sbyar ba yin gyi/ gsang 'dus rang rkang tshugs pa'i rab gnas ni ma yin no/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi rab gnas 'bring po'i ngag 'don/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
